latest_release.name: Release 26.11.13
latest_release.body:
## Changes

- chore(deps): bump astral-sh/setup-uv from 10.3.2 to 10.3.3 @[dependabot[bot]](https://github.com/apps/dependabot) (#5229)

## Features

- feat: queue actions while a job is running, with reorder and cancel @vyas-devgna (#5207)
- feat(ui): add working view to Install and Tweaks tabs @Compourri (#5147)
- Add tweak to disable Windows Search indexing (WSearch) @malinfossum (#5223)

## Bug Fixes

- feat(install): bundle app icons and speed up the app list @vyas-devgna (#5199)
- Restore WaaSMedicSvc and clear SYSTEM deny rules in Restore Defaults @deaguss (#5233)
- fix(tweaks): don\t fail the Telemetry tweak when Defender is unavailable @adiraj66132 (#5193)
- Skip disabling BitLocker when the system drive is already decrypted @mewclouds (#5162)
- fix(ui): keep maximized window title bar on screen @vyas-devgna (#5197)
- Fix session log missing everything after the window opens @seanh1995 (#5210)
- Revert back the docs workflow generator step from #5220 @seanh1995 (#5222)
- fix(docs): escape generated metadata before site builds @ChrisTitusTech (#5220)

## Documentation

- feat: queue actions while a job is running, with reorder and cancel @vyas-devgna (#5207)
- docs: fix missing word in README introduction (plus little emoji) @v5freake-collab (#5192)
- Add tweak to disable Windows Search indexing (WSearch) @malinfossum (#5223)
- Fix session log missing everything after the window opens @seanh1995 (#5210)
- Revert back the docs workflow generator step from #5220 @seanh1995 (#5222)
- fix(docs): escape generated metadata before site builds @ChrisTitusTech (#5220)

## UI/UX Improvements

- feat: queue actions while a job is running, with reorder and cancel @vyas-devgna (#5207)
- feat(install): bundle app icons and speed up the app list @vyas-devgna (#5199)
- feat(ui): add working view to Install and Tweaks tabs @Compourri (#5147)
